blocks.text: ZPC offers you to view or schedule reports for all available benchmarks.
The Scheduled Reports page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View all the scheduled compliance reports.

blocks.text: On the Scheduled Reports page (Administration > Scheduled Reports), you can:

blocks.item: Search for a specific schedule report in the searchable columns.
Modify the table and its columns. You can choose which columns appear on the report table. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Edit or delete a schedule report.
Enable or disable a schedule report.
